failures.evidence: A new browser profile, signed in as a person who typed nothing, opens a closed issue's spec and the status pill reads "connected · 1 edit saved in this browser can't be sent: this document is read-only." The red test is "a closed issue's document names no unsent edit to a person who typed nothing" in packages/dispatch/e2e/close-withdraws-asks.e2e.ts. Command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- close-withdraws-asks.e2e.ts -g "names no unsent edit" --repeat-each 3. Result at head 39c12172: 6 failed (chromium x3, iphone x3), each at toHaveAccessibleName("connected"), with Received "connected · 1 edit saved in this browser can't be sent: this document is read-only.". Main's build 383b889d does the same (issue BC-1 on a fresh database), so the change does not cause it, but the tree fixes it under the rule above. failures.criterion: No document write that changes nothing appends an update or marks its document owing a settlement (the architect names this to be fixed in this PR)
failures.evidence: The implementer's own openQuestion in .legion/INFRA-158/implement.json: applyLive (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/mutation.go) appends the update ygo emits for a transaction that changes nothing, for every writer. Only WriteIssueAskStates was fixed, at its caller. Any other writer that opens a no-op transaction appends an empty update and marks its document as owing a settlement. The architect directs the general fix in applyLive. No red test from the tester: the implementer's TestARepairThatChangesNothingAppendsNoUpdateAndMarksNoDocument pins the caller's case, and the general case needs a test at applyLive.

verifiedWithoutDefect: Closes of TT-1 by alice (cookie PATCH, 0.09 s), TT-2 by an agent session (dispatch issue-update --status done) and TT-3 by SetStatus (99 ms). Each issue held an open decision block copied into a second document, an answered block, plain asks waiting on a person and on the agent, a person's ask, an approval request, and a retracted and a resolved ask. After each close: open_asks 0, approval draft, 'Open asks: - none', every open ask Kind withdrawn By <closer>, the live blocks and the copy resolved, named versions byte-identical, no new version. The answered, retracted and resolved asks were unchanged. In Chromium: no 'Waiting on' header, no 'Awaiting approval' button, and each card reads 'Withdrawn when legion-daemon:TT closed the issue'.

Reopen by alice and by the agent: the same 5 ids are open again with their waiting_on, back in the Inbox, approval awaiting, blocks open. Then 4 close/reopen cycles by the daemon, the agent and alice: a retract and an answer made between cycles stayed, and every withdrawal named that cycle's closer.

Refusals on a closed issue: answer 409 ISSUE_CLOSED; resolve-ask 'issue is closed'; --kind withdrawn refused by the CLI; ask, doc-edit (a new decision block) and request-approval all refused with 'issue is closed' or ISSUE_CLOSED.

Races, 95 rounds with 0 problems and no 5xx: close against resolve and answer (all 4 interleavings), two closes at once (200 and 409, each ask withdrawn once), a block inserted just before the close (withdrawn with its author, 15/15), close/reopen/close at once, and two head processes on one database with the room on B and the close on A (blocks resolved through both, asks withdrawn).

Upgrade: closes on main's build 383b889d left open_asks 5. Booting the head logged withdrawn=15 and named each issue's latest closer (old-agent-6 after a reclose). In the roll, main's build reopened 2 issues and the head restored their 10 asks.
Browser suite close-withdraws-asks.e2e.ts at the head: 6 passed.
